Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in integrating nitrogen-doped carbon nanofibers with cerium dioxide composite electrodes to accelerate TiO2+/Ti3+ redox kinetics in Ti-Ce redox flow batteries. This addresses sluggish electrode catalysis, a key barrier to RFB performance. The significance is enabling faster kinetics and improved electrode stability, supporting scalable, cost-effective large-scale energy storage.
